bibl.title: Vairāgyaśataka
bibl.note: Unni, N. P. Nilakantha Diksita. Sahitya Akademi, 1995.

The Vairāgyaśataka is a collection of 101 stanzas composed in the Āryā metre, dealing with the fickleness of worldly life; it recalls Bhartṛhari's famous Vairāgyaśataka and also draws on ideas from Śaṅkarācārya's Mohamudgara.
